scope: Independent code audit and representation-only changes to actual natural-text coefficients; no synthetic corpus or labels
exact_arithmetic_canonicalization_proof: If U changes to U R, R orthogonal, residual coefficient vectors and chosen unit directions change by R transpose. Norm scores and smallest-index pivot selection are invariant, and U R times R transpose direction equals U direction. Induction proves identical ambient basis in exact arithmetic.
remaining_contract_limits: No floating byte-canonicality: rank and pivot ties are numerically unstable; no tolerance-based pruning is done.
Dense versus compact representation mode can depend on history because dense keys stay dense; canonical basis alone does not prove full-state equality to a fresh build.
Checkpoint load duplicates one current array during copy, and keeps current metadata; total memory and process peak were not measured here.
Shape validation uses assertions for several invariants and is a research checkpoint reader, not a hostile-file security boundary.
